author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

The `JetHTall` test was failing in tests of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51867#issuecomment-5964366090 with
```
TESTING JetHT plotting
/data/cmsbld/jenkins/workspace/ib-run-pr-tests/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-02-1100/unit_tests/JetHTall/test_yaml/JetHT/plot/testMC /data/cmsbld/jenkins/workspace/ib-run-pr-tests/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-02-1100/unit_tests/JetHTall
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'edm::Exception'
  what():  An exception of category 'FileInPathError' occurred.
Exception Message:
The path must be relative, not absolute: /cvmfs/cms-ib.cern.ch/sw/x86_64/nweek-02961/el9_amd64_gcc14/cms/cmssw-patch/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-02-1100/external/el9_amd64_gcc14/data/Alignment/OfflineValidation/data/lumiPerRun_Run2.txt

./run.sh: line 7: 490072 Aborted                 (core dumped) ./jetHtPlotter validation.json
Failure running JetHT plotting: status 134
```
https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/jenkins-artifacts/pull-request-integration/PR-ab372f/56334/unitTests/src/Alignment/OfflineValidation/test/JetHTall/testing.log

It seems that the `edm::FileInPath` is being passed an absolute path, and https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51867 explicitly explicitly forbids it.

This PR changes the `jetHtPlotter.cc` to use `edm::FileInPath` only if the input file path is relative.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2457

#### PR validation:

The `JetHTall` unit test passes when run with https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51867
title: Use `edm::FileInPath::findFile()` only with relative paths in `jetHtPlotter.cc`
